description: React component for adding and configuring guardrails in a UI, including provider selection, mode, PII, content filtering, and provider-specific parameters.

classes.name: AddGuardrailForm
classes.description: React functional component for adding guardrails with multiple configuration steps, provider-specific settings, and validation.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles change of guardrail provider, resets provider-specific form fields and state.

methods.name: handleActionSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of actions for PII entities.

methods.name: handleCategorySelect
methods.description: Handles selection/deselection of content categories for Azure Text Moderation.

methods.name: handleGlobalSeverityChange
methods.description: Updates global severity threshold for Azure Text Moderation.

methods.name: handleCategorySeverityChange
methods.description: Updates severity threshold for specific content categories.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Validates current step and advances to the next step.

methods.name: prevStep
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets all form fields and state to initial values.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets the form.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form, constructs guardrail data payload, and submits to backend.

methods.name: renderBasicInfo
methods.description: Renders the initial form fields for guardrail name, provider, mode, and provider-specific fields.

methods.name: renderPiiConfiguration
methods.description: Renders PII configuration component if provider is PresidioPII.

methods.name: renderOptionalParams
methods.description: Renders provider-specific optional parameters or tool permission editor.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Determines and renders content for the current step.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the multi-step form.
